newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Oct 1-25 palm oil exports 615,327t - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Oct 1-25 palm oil exports 615,327t - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor, Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Monday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for October 1-25 at 615,327 tonnes compared with 528,150 tonnes for September 1-25.
It said the exports comprised 138,533 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 282,760 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 68,432 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products accounted for 125,602 tonnes.
India was the top buyer during the period, taking 99,820 tonnes followed by China which bought 88,000 tonnes, Pakistan (73,250 tonnes) and United States (34,028 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 101,523 tonnes while Middle East countries took 45,550 tonnes.
